versions.changelog:
No user-facing changes in this release.

- Version increment to 1.0.1; no modifications to code or documentation detected.

- Initial release of the Purchase Order Recognition and Extraction skill.
- Supports accurate extraction of all key fields from purchase and sales orders in various formats.
- Outputs structured JSON for integration with business systems.
- Zero-configuration setup; works out-of-the-box using Laiye ADP CLI.
- Suitable for e-commerce order entry, supply chain reconciliation, and warehouse management automation.
- New users receive 100 free credits per month (covers up to 66 pages).
